body:
graph: keep the graph non empty without embeddings ( #30522 )

An embedding-only graph has no logits, and build_pooling() returns

early when embeddings are off, so since the models no longer expand

t_embd the graph ends up empty and its inputs are never allocated.

Expand t_embd in that case.
